📦 **Sharkside `197897b`** — art: deliver gunpowder keg, baby shark, chain shot and nursery medal

Add wpn/keg, upg/pups, wpn/chain and ach/pup500 as 128x128 RGBA icons. Verify binary alpha, <=104px silhouettes and >=12px margins against current data IDs. Review keg16-64px at eight rotations, baby14-40px, chain20-40px and medal40px on dark/light backgrounds beside existing assets. Preserve generated sources, exact prompts and reference/source/output SHA-256. Integration and fallback remain for gura.
